description_en: Sets the property values of multiple devices
description_zh: 调用该接口批量设置设备属性值
kebab_example: aliyun iot set-devices-property --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --items Switch_:1,_Color_:_blue --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDevicesProperty

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If the instance has an ID, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices whose property values you want to set belong
parameters.help_zh: 要设置属性值的设备所属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the message delivery method. Valid values:

0: At most once.
1: At least once. If a message with QoS=1 does not receive a PUBACK message, the message is pushed to the device again when the device reconnects.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 0 is used.

For more information about communication messages, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30527.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定消息的发送方式。取值：

0：最多发送一次。
1：最少发送一次。如果QoS=1消息未接收到PUBACK消息，会在设备重连时，重新推送给设备。

如果不传入此参数，则使用默认值0。

通信消息的更多使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/30527.html
parameters.name: qos

parameters.help_en:
The property information that you want to set. The data format is JSON.

Each property consists of an identifier and a property value (key:value). Separate multiple properties with commas (,).

For example, to set two properties of a smart light:
The switch property whose identifier is Switch. The data type is Bool and the value is set to 1 (on).
The light color property whose identifier is Color. The data type is String and the value is set to blue.

The property information in JSON format is as follows:

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

If you want to set the properties of a custom module named testFb (not the default module), the format is: `Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的属性信息，数据格式为JSON。

每个属性信息由标识符与属性值（key:value）构成，多个属性用英文逗号隔开。

例如，设置智能灯的两个属性：
标识符为Switch的开关属性，数据类型为Bool，设置值为1（开）。
标识符为Color的灯颜色属性，数据类型为String，设置值为blue。

那么要设置的属性信息，JSON格式如下：

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

如果设置自定义模块testFb（非默认模块）的属性，则格式为：`Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`
parameters.name: items

parameters.help_en: The list of device names for which you want to set property values. You can specify 1 to 100 device names
parameters.help_zh: 要设置属性值的设备名称列表。设备名称的个数范围为1~100个
parameters.name: device_name
